    40	irreducibility produce the stable affine cover directly, without an immersion binder. -/

    70	    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor ((baseChange K P.N.1).obj C)).RepresentableBy P.gluedOver)
    71	    (hproj : P.gluedMap.IsProjective) :
